summary: The proposal extends Spark’s Real-Time Mode to eligible distributed batch SQL and DataFrame queries, enabling pipelined shuffle that overlaps producer, transfer, and consumer stages to reduce latency and improve throughput. It also covers write restrictions, leakage prevention, backward‑compatibility via a capability signal, and flexible mask functions, with tests for each guarantee. The proposal introduces a method to join streaming data with external storage by performing on-demand lookups instead of loading the entire static side. Monitoring shows a failure rate that rises sharply with PR size, prompting consideration of limiting large PRs or splitting them.
